{ ============================================================================
  GT1 - Functions / Indicators / Language ground-truth  (MultiCharts PowerLanguage)
  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TYPE:  INDICATOR  (PowerLanguage Editor -> New -> Indicator)

  WHAT IT DOES
    Calculates over every bar and appends one comma-delimited row per bar to
    OutPath. That file is the bar-by-bar ground truth for the transpiler.

  STYLE (KISS)
    - Every output value is computed into its own variable on its own line.
    - The CSV row is a single FLAT concatenation of NumToStr(var,..) terms:
      no nested function calls, no conditionals inside the Print.
    - Assignment is '='  (never ':='). EasyLanguage idioms only.

  GROUNDING
    Every keyword, function, operator and bracket below is grounded in the
    official PowerLanguage Keyword Reference and/or TradeStation help; see
    ground_truth/GROUNDING.md for the per-token citation table.

  RUN
    Delete any old OutPath file first (Print(File()) appends). Apply to a fixed
    symbol / interval / date-range and record them. Reload once to capture.
============================================================================ }
Inputs:
	Len( 14 ),
	Prec( 6 ),
	OutPath( "C:\pl_gt\GT1_funcs.csv" ) ;

Vars:
	Counter( 0 ),
	RunSum( 0 ),
	prevclose( 0 ),
	PrevCounter( 0 ),
	ForSum( 0 ),
	SmaManual( 0 ),
	IfElseOut( 0 ),
	AvgC( 0 ),
	XAvgC( 0 ),
	RsiC( 0 ),
	HiH( 0 ),
	LoL( 0 ),
	SumC( 0 ),
	StdDevC( 0 ),
	MomC( 0 ),
	RocC( 0 ),
	CciC( 0 ),
	AtrC( 0 ),
	TrueRangeC( 0 ),
	MedPrice( 0 ),
	RangeC( 0 ),
	MacdC( 0 ),
	AbsV( 0 ),
	SqrV( 0 ),
	SqrtV( 0 ),
	PowrV( 0 ),
	LnV( 0 ),
	ExpV( 0 ),
	IntP( 0 ),
	FracP( 0 ),
	SgnV( 0 ),
	ModV( 0 ),
	MaxL( 0 ),
	MinL( 0 ),
	RndV( 0 ),
	CeilV( 0 ),
	FloorV( 0 ),
	CrossUpN( 0 ),
	CrossDnN( 0 ),
	StrLenV( 0 ),
	InStrV( 0 ),
	LeftS( "" ),
	RightS( "" ),
	UpperS( "" ),
	Idx( 0 ),
	Line( "" ) ;

Arrays: Buf[200]( 0 ) ;

{ ---- cross-bar persistence ---- }
Counter = Counter + 1 ;
RunSum = RunSum + close ;

{ ---- user-variable history references ---- }
prevclose = close[1] ;
PrevCounter = Counter[1] ;

{ ---- For loop + array: manual SMA of the last Len closes ---- }
ForSum = 0 ;
For Idx = 0 to Len - 1 Begin
	Buf[Idx] = close[Idx] ;
	ForSum = ForSum + Buf[Idx] ;
End ;

SmaManual = ForSum / Len ;

{ ---- single-level If / Then / Else ---- }
If close > open Then IfElseOut = 1 ;
Else IfElseOut = -1 ;

{ ---- indicator / series functions (one per line) ---- }
AvgC = average(close, Len) ;
XAvgC = xaverage(close, Len) ;
RsiC = rsi(close, Len) ;
HiH = highest(high, Len) ;
LoL = lowest(low, Len) ;
SumC = summation(close, Len) ;
StdDevC = standarddev(close, Len, 1) ;
MomC = momentum(close, Len) ;
RocC = rateofchange(close, Len) ;
CciC = cci(Len) ;
AtrC = avgtruerange(Len) ;
TrueRangeC = truerange ;
MedPrice = medianprice ;
RangeC = range ;
MacdC = macd(close, 12, 26) ;

{ ---- math functions (one per line) ---- }
AbsV = AbsValue(close - open) ;
SqrV = Square(close - open) ;
SqrtV = SquareRoot(AbsValue(close)) ;
PowrV = Power(2, 3) ;
LnV = Log(AbsValue(close) + 1) ;
ExpV = ExpValue(1) ;
IntP = IntPortion(close) ;
FracP = FracPortion(close) ;
SgnV = Sign(close - open) ;
ModV = barnumber mod 5 ;
MaxL = MaxList(open, high, low, close) ;
MinL = MinList(open, high, low, close) ;
RndV = Round(close, 2) ;
CeilV = Ceiling(close) ;
FloorV = Floor(close) ;

{ ---- crosses -> numeric 1/0 (computed here, never nested in the output) ---- }
CrossUpN = 0 ;
If close crosses above AvgC Then CrossUpN = 1 ;
CrossDnN = 0 ;
If close crosses below AvgC Then CrossDnN = 1 ;

{ ---- string functions ---- }
StrLenV = strlen("abcdef") ;
InStrV = instr("abcdef", "cd") ;
LeftS = leftstr("abcdef", 3) ;
RightS = rightstr("abcdef", 2) ;
UpperS = upperstr("abc") ;

{ ---- header row, written once ---- }
Once Print( File(OutPath),
	"bn,date,time,close,prevclose,counter,prevcounter,runsum,smamanual,ifelse,avg,xavg,rsi,highest,lowest,summ,stddev,mom,roc,cci,atr,truerange,medprice,range,macd,absv,sqr,sqrt,powr,ln,exp,intp,fracp,sign,mod,maxl,minl,round,ceil,floor,crossup,crossdn,strlen,instr,lefts,rights,uppers"
	) ;

{ ---- build the CSV row: flat, one term per source value, no nesting ---- }
Line = numtostr(barnumber, 0) + "," + numtostr(date, 0) + "," + numtostr(time, 0) + "," +
	numtostr(close, Prec) + "," + numtostr(prevclose, Prec) + "," + numtostr(Counter, 0) + "," +
	numtostr(PrevCounter, 0) + "," + numtostr(RunSum, Prec) + "," + numtostr(SmaManual, Prec) + "," +
	numtostr(IfElseOut, 0) + "," + numtostr(AvgC, Prec) + "," + numtostr(XAvgC, Prec) + "," +
	numtostr(RsiC, Prec) + "," + numtostr(HiH, Prec) + "," + numtostr(LoL, Prec) + "," + numtostr(SumC,
	Prec) + "," + numtostr(StdDevC, Prec) + "," + numtostr(MomC, Prec) + "," + numtostr(RocC, Prec) +
	"," + numtostr(CciC, Prec) + "," + numtostr(AtrC, Prec) + "," + numtostr(TrueRangeC, Prec) + "," +
	numtostr(MedPrice, Prec) + "," + numtostr(RangeC, Prec) + "," + numtostr(MacdC, Prec) + "," +
	numtostr(AbsV, Prec) + "," + numtostr(SqrV, Prec) + "," + numtostr(SqrtV, Prec) + "," +
	numtostr(PowrV, Prec) + "," + numtostr(LnV, Prec) + "," + numtostr(ExpV, Prec) + "," +
	numtostr(IntP, Prec) + "," + numtostr(FracP, Prec) + "," + numtostr(SgnV, 0) + "," + numtostr(ModV,
	0) + "," + numtostr(MaxL, Prec) + "," + numtostr(MinL, Prec) + "," + numtostr(RndV, 2) + "," +
	numtostr(CeilV, Prec) + "," + numtostr(FloorV, Prec) + "," + numtostr(CrossUpN, 0) + "," +
	numtostr(CrossDnN, 0) + "," + numtostr(StrLenV, 0) + "," + numtostr(InStrV, 0) + "," + LeftS + ","
	+ RightS + "," + UpperS ;

Print( File(OutPath), Line ) ;

{ visible plot so the indicator is obviously calculating on the chart }
plot1( AvgC ) ;
